name: patientchain-caliper-benchmarks
description: Hyperledger Caliper benchmarks for the PatientChain chaincode: measures Caction(b) across orderer batch sizes (Section 3.4.4 / Table 3.9).

scripts.benchmark:smoke: caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace ./ --caliper-networkconfig networks/fabric-network.yaml --caliper-benchconfig benchmarks/config-smoke.yaml --caliper-flow-only-test --caliper-fabric-timeout-invokeorquery 120 --caliper-report-path results/smoke/report.html
scripts.bench: npm run bind && npm run benchmark
scripts.check: for f in workload/*.js scripts/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
